formatting.method: Read locked cargo metadata, select every workspace member target, deduplicate target source paths by edition, and invoke rustfmt --check --edition in argument batches below the Windows command-line limit. Module traversal uses the default rustfmt behavior.

test_accounting: 1100 parser/expression unit tests, 14 public core integration targets and four CLI integration targets. Earlier development, pre-format and overlapping publication-ledger checks are excluded. All six selected WASM targets passed in one invocation. No selected tests are ignored.
source_hash_format: SHA-256 of committed Git blob bytes
implementation: A private temperature-pass error preserves the original public ParseWithAbortError and optionally carries a different discovered setting. Only its error payload is boxed, avoiding a large error return on the ordinary parser stack.

After a deferred analysis fails, staging continues only as far as the last later TEMP card needed for physical selection. The first failure remains authoritative and no staged analysis/output/diagnostic effects are published from the failed completion.

The replay candidate combines authored TEMP/TNOM options, the last scalar-versus-sweep TEMP disposition and physical study override precedence. Temperature lists are not cloned merely to retain this disposition.

A fresh immutable-source parse must succeed and agree with its selected temperatures before returning a netlist. The existing three-pass bound and seed reconstruction remain intact. Cancellation and resource failures never request another pass.
acceptance_evidence: The baseline two-case development run failed the AC operand 1/(TEMP-27) before reaching parameter-selected TEMP=85; its deferred-source comparison already passed. The final public AC regression checks both frequency endpoints equal 1/58.

Scalar TEMP overrides options in either authored order, later scalar directives supersede earlier ones, and a final sweep disposition does not retain an earlier scalar override. Nested scoped TEMP expressions can complete after an invalid provisional AC operand.

An independent seeded stream checks the AC operand, later sampled TEMP, a following pending DC operand and the next draw after reconciliation. Inactive literal temperature hints and captured user functions retain their intended behavior.
Final division errors, missing TEMP operands and changing temperature selections remain failures. Included typed PSS errors retain child.inc:1 after replay.

Private boundary tests retain a physical TEMP override while TNOM changes, stop on cancellation as replay begins, and prove terminal resource/cancellation errors invoke no retry. Existing parameter/global/source/analysis/control and CLI temperature/error suites remain active.
limits: The broader provisional-temperature task remains open: eager PARAM/option-field errors and failures before analysis completion can still prevent discovery. Conditional and general dependency planning, temperature-dependent statistics, and allocation/performance qualification remain incomplete.
This batch does not close any C00-C14 package or establish full model/numerical/runtime/profile parity.

CLI runtime tests retain Rust 1.95 qualification because earlier pinned compiler incidents remain unresolved. Previous native WASM-runner access violations also remain C14 work; a successful invocation here does not establish general tool reproducibility.

formatting_workaround.outcome: Windows command-line length failure before formatting
formatting_workaround.replacement: Equivalent registered-target checks in bounded rustfmt argument batches; see formatting.

development_notes: Corrected one test assertion that assumed uppercase spelling in a preserved raw-expression diagnostic. Strict Clippy rejected the initial private error size; boxing its error payload resolved the lint. Integrated nine newer remote-main commits, including formatting, matrix dependency and native-only reqwest streaming changes, before final qualification. Final netlist checks were rerun after formatting; public integration compilation used the same committed source. No implementation tests were weakened or ignored.

publication_validation.scope: Requirements/evidence-path validation after documentation changes; excluded from implementation test counts.
